description: Retrieve assets for stored post identifiers. TikTok photo/carousel posts return ordered signed slide images; video posts return video/frame assets. Missing frame extraction or requested analysis may incur processing cost under existing controls. Returns per-item state and source links; poll analysis by returned ID, not URL. Observed hooks, shots and transcripts are returned alongside model interpretations; likelyReasonItRanks and similar explanations are hypotheses, not measured ranking causes or proof of effectiveness. Photo/carousel analysis uses one-based slideIndex references and has no video timing, motion or audio evidence. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation, pricing, balance and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.
